pli-tv-bu-vb-pc60:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc60:1.2: tena kho pana samayena sattarasavaggiyā bhikkhū asannihitaparikkhārā honti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc60:1.3: chabbaggiyā bhikkhū sattarasavaggiyānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ pattaṃ pi cīvaraṃ pi apanidhenti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc60:1.4: sattarasavaggiyā bhikkhū chabbaggiye bhikkhū etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc60:1.5: dethāvuso amhākaṃ pattaṃ pi cīvaraṃ pīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc60:1.9: ime āvuso chabbaggiyā bhikkhū amhākaṃ pattaṃ pi cīvaraṃ pi apanidhentīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc60:1.11: kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū bhikkhūnaṃ pattaṃ pi cīvaraṃ pi apanidhessantīti --pa--.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc60:1.12: saccaṃ kira tumhe bhikkhave bhikkhūnaṃ . . . apanidhethā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc60:1.15: hi nāma tumhe moghapurisā bhikkhūnaṃ . . . apanidhessatha.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc60:1.16: n' etaṃ moghapurisā appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya --pa--
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc60:1.17: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc60:1.18.1: yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhussa pattaṃ vā cīvaraṃ vā nisīdanaṃ vā sūcigharaṃ vā kāyabandhanaṃ vā apanidheyya vā apanidhāpeyya vā antamaso hāsāpekkho pi, pācittiyan ti. ||1||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc60:2.1.21: sakiṃ āṇatto bahukaṃ pi apanidheti, āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc60:2.2.1: upasampanne upasampannasaññī pattaṃ vā . . . kāyabandhanaṃ vā apanidheti vā apanidhāpeti vā antamaso hāsāpekkho pi, āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc60:2.2.4: aññaṃ parikkhāraṃ apanidheti vā apanidhāpeti vā antamaso hāsāpekkho pi, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc60:2.2.5: anupasampannassa pattaṃ vā cīvaraṃ vā aññaṃ vā parikkhāraṃ apanidheti vā apanidhāpeti vā antamaso hāsāpekkho pi, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
